startup_attempts.reason: Cached tokenizer files are symlinks to owned cache blobs; regular-file hash helper initially rejected the symlink. Fixed by validating cache containment then hashing resolved files.
Installed Transformers availability detection imported Torch despite USE_TORCH=0. The post-load no-Torch guard rejected the run before any output. No model construction/inference was called.

A cold environment-only AutoTokenizer probe confirmed Torch import; no model/weights/inference. An explicit import-blocking finder failed during availability discovery; a None sentinel successfully represented Torch as unavailable.

limitations: No production disk space has been freed: both original and compact files remain. The new representation adds12.86MB of prototype data.
Existing registry and builders still require old windows.sqlite3; never remove it or claim increased semantic/search coverage based on this prototype.
Canonical source namespace and exact source guards are required for reconstruction; this is not an independent text archive.
Partial staging transactions are removed on failure; resumable compact production consumption and migration are separate unimplemented work.
Peak RSS is493MiB on this measured environment, not a guarantee for different libraries/tokenizers.
The final measured process loaded no actual Torch/FAISS/llama.cpp module. Earlier explicitly recorded diagnostic attempts did import Torch, without model weights or inference.
